scene: You peer into the sparkling fountain, where curious mechanical fish swim.
picture: A close first-person view of the stone fountain rim and clear pool. On the left, a marble pedestal rises with an empty coin slot. In the centre, a brass clockwork carp glides through sparkling water. On the right, a tarnished bronze plaque displays ornate engraved script, while a grandmotherly hand rests near the edge.
